status: pre-candidate data for root freeze; not execution evidence
authorship: All document/selection/output/map literals authored independently from stated policy and source map definitions; no candidate/native/WASM/browser/test invoked.
canonical_rule: klenwriter-canonical-json-v1; ASCII keys + exact integer-only authored literals; compact scalar-key sort, literal UTF-8, no final newline
wire_macro_rule: Role strings substitute exact native tokens; exact_current_stamp substitutes the captured current StampDto; $after_state means native StateDto independently checked against after document/selection/IDs and execute_facets/history assertions. It is a data macro, not an invented wire field. Query nested diagnostics have stamp:null; outer refused command/read diagnostics have current stamp.
role_rule: ROOT is virtual session root; numeric arrays locate child-index paths from document.content. Roles bind native opaque tokens by literal input topology. New live roles bind output objects and must differ from every input token. No concrete token number assumptions.

planning_order: remove maximal middle forest in document order
remove maximal middle forest in document order

format_positive_literal.undo: revision2 exact original canonical/roles/directed selection; created B/N retired
format_positive_literal.redo: revision3 exact after canonical/roles/directed selection; same B/N tokens

other_limit_contracts.details_policy: Preserve actual LimitExceeded name/maximum/observed; never substitute empty details. WorkMeter names are transaction_work and transaction_bytes.

limit_reachability_qualification: These are hard maxima, not a claim each is independently reachable through admitted KWDJ/public transport before another lower guard. Fixed-bound native unit literals must use a private lowered-budget reader with no public testing setter; public cap0/1/2/overmax are concrete literals above. Do not inflate valid documents solely to defeat upstream admission.
map_derivation_sources: crates/engine/src/tree.rs:2221-2285 detach emits ChildDelete then Retire

compatibility.read: ABI2-only thin BridgeRequestV2/SdkReplyV2/SdkResponseV2 wrappers and optional BridgeAdapter callback; no query registry
compatibility.new_command_profile_intent: explicit additive17, catalog entries must decode in every advertised lane

clipboard_policy.before_delete: same mount/context/stamp/intent serial; exactly one isolated new17 submit
clipboard_policy.stale_after_write: copied_but_not_cut; preserve actual native/ownership refusal, no map/reselection/replay
